about: koha.nexus direct Z39.50 servers: the primary copy-cataloguing targets, from the validated list of 2026-10-18 and the confirmed scan of 2026-10-27. python -m nexus_gateway panel-list puts them first in the panel's list; the koha.nexus SRU gateway rows (127.0.0.1:5000/sru/<id>) follow as the fallback, for libraries and regions no direct server covers. "sru_fallback" names the gateway id a direct server replaces; "alternates" are other addresses the list gave for the same catalogue; "unconfirmed" marks a host or database the list left open ("x ou y"). Logins never go here: "login_env" names the .env variables (<name>_USER, <name>_PASSWORD).

fallback.rule: used only when no direct Z39.50 server covers the library or region; ranked after every direct server and never preselected
